status.description: Return only keys in this lifecycle state. Omitted returns every state, including revoked keys.

contextId.description: Return only keys filed under this scope.

offset.description: Zero-based index of the first record to return.

limit.description: Maximum records to return. The custodian MAY return fewer and MAY impose its own ceiling; `total` says how many matched.

Response.title: Keys List — response payload
Response.description: The success response to a keys/list request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/keys/list/0.1#response.

keys.description: The page of records, in the custodian's own order.

total.description: How many records matched the filters in total. Required so a short page is never mistaken for the end of the set — the failure that makes a key audit or rotation sweep look complete when it is not.

offset.description: The offset this page starts at.

limit.description: The page size actually applied, which MAY be smaller than the one requested.
